scope: actual immutable ledger validator, not whole diagnosis or GUI
build_profile: debug, before and after linked against their actual checkout library
method: Identical probe source linked before and after the code change. Capture one strict-valid live five-generation ledger once, then read the same immutable JSON in both probes. Each process parses the fixture and performs five warmup validations before measurement. Twenty alternating paired rounds measure fifty actual generation_ledger_integrity_ok calls, allocation/reallocation requests and cumulative requested bytes using a counting System allocator. Process startup and input parse are outside measurement. Every validation succeeds; initial/final ledger and fixture bytes match. The production actual-reader regression separately proves two fresh strict validations and snapshot decode count 4 to 2.

separate_installed_observation.qualification: Installed older binary, not the checkout candidate or a before/after causal comparison; threads surviving both sample boundaries only.

limitations: Shared-host debug validator timings do not measure full strict loads, diagnosis, GUI, release CPU, deployed fleet or PM-prompt errors.
Allocation requests and cumulative requested bytes are not live retained allocations, RSS, private bytes or a long-duration memory slope.
